# AbortBreaking

**Category:** Exploit  
**Aliases:** AbortBreaking

## What it does

AbortBreaking lets you stop mining a block partway through without throwing away the progress you've already made. Normally, if you release the attack key before a block fully breaks, the server resets your mining progress and you have to start over from scratch. With this module enabled, that cancellation is suppressed, so the block keeps the damage you've dealt and you can resume right where you left off.

Description basis: [publisher description](https://liquidbounce.net/docs/modules/exploit/abortbreaking). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).
